caption:
Nvidia's CEO quit. AMD took the bigger hit: AMD closed down 8.75% at $534.06 Friday, Nvidia down 2.01%.
AMD rallied Thursday on bets orders shift to rivals, then the chip sector sold off as the scandal looked like an industry-wide risk. Next test: Nvidia earnings, Tue Nov 17.
